column1: # check:dup ceilings, read up front by dup.sh. One row per tracked large file: <repo-relative path>, a TAB, the percent.
# A file over jscpd's size limit (1000 lines or 100kb) is measured alone; above its row, or over 5% with no row, fails.
# The *combined* row is the whole-repo combined baseline (the no-argument run only). A figure never rises: dedupe the test.
